requirement: Add URL expiration and lifecycle management

analysis.normalizedRequirement: Add optional URL expiration and lifecycle behavior while preserving existing links

acceptanceCriteria.description: Creation accepts an optional expiresAt in UTC ISO-8601 format
An expired URL returns HTTP 410 Gone
A nonexistent short code returns HTTP 404 Not Found
Existing URLs without expiration continue to work

assumptions: Expiration timestamps are evaluated using an injected UTC clock
ambiguities: Whether already-expired timestamps should be rejected or stored as expired

planApproval.rationale: Acceptance criteria, task graph, and risks reviewed
